# Torque Blog

Torque is a modern, high-performance blogging platform optimized for speed, security, and developer productivity. It is built using Next.js and Cloudflare Pages.

## Core Features
- Full-featured blog with categories, tags, and comments.
- Rich-text editor powered by TipTap.
- Admin dashboard for post management, categories, and tags.
- Secure authentication using JWT and password hashing.
- High-performance Edge database (Cloudflare D1) and Media storage (Cloudflare R2).

## APIs for Agents
- GET /api/posts: List all public posts.
- GET /api/categories: List all categories.
- GET /api/tags: List all tags.
